title: The invention of lithography
version: Dated not specified. Offenbach city history institution
lineage: Says music prints appeared from 1800 and that Senefelder trained André’s workers. It also gives an earlier 1799 commercial-use claim without identifying a surviving product in that year. The city webpage reproduces excerpts of the 1799 contract and newspaper notice; their separate original physical copies were not independently inspected.

passages.note: Opening and “Offenbach – the cradle of lithography” sections
“The beginnings of success”: transcribed 28 September 1799 contract and future training
“First successfully operating lithographic print shop”: 26 September 1799 newspaper notice offering stone printing generically
